response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt FROM per p, overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS kavg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, k.avg_cnt - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall_avg, k.avg_cnt - ka.kavg AS diff_above_kept_avg FROM kept k, overall o, kept_avg ka ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-transaction averages. Transactions whose anlycount is all NULL have a NULL average and are excluded from that mean and from the kept set.
The difference from the kept-group average can be negative for kept transactions that are below that group's average. Negative values are shown as is.
